zh: 修复 ROM 总目录下多个子目录的机种识别和刷新范围。相邻目录可各自识别机种，索引和 CUE 仍可引用授权范围内的其他子目录。
修复双屏设备在游戏运行期间显示闲置画面时抢走手柄焦点的问题，闲置画面仍可触摸操作。
存档设置为 Eden 新增 Switch 玩家存档关联，可按玩家和游戏分别配置 WebDAV 同步。
en: Fixed platform detection and refresh scope for subfolders in a ROM library. Neighboring folders can be identified independently, and indexes and CUE files can still reference other subfolders within the granted directory.
Fixed the idle screen taking controller focus from a running game on dual-screen devices. The idle screen still responds to touch.
Added a Switch player-save option to Eden's save settings, with WebDAV sync configured separately for each player and game.
